programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia terminan sus estudios y tienen una vida adulta e independiente por delante. Los jóvenes se aman desde hace tiempo y con devoción y ya piensan en formar una familia. Un día, el padre de Ksenia, que trabaja como jefe de una empresa de construcción, se mete en problemas. Es sospechoso de blanqueo de dinero a gran escala y en un futuro próximo no sólo se arriesga a perder todo su patrimonio, sino también a ir a la cárcel durante mucho tiempo. De repente, un viejo conocido de la madre de Ksenia, Grigory Dmitrievich, que ocupa un alto cargo en la administración local de la ciudad, se ofrece a resolver los problemas de su padre. Sin embargo, pone una única condición a cambio: Ksenia debe casarse con su hijo Dima, un futuro pintor que estudia pintura en un colegio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Han pasado veinte años. Una familia de un renombrado artista llega a la ciudad costera para pasar el verano. Se trata de Dmitri, Ksenia y su hija Rita. Pronto, Ksenia recibe una invitación para una reunión de excompañeros de escuela y decide asistir. En el fondo, no puede negar su deseo de volver a ver a Piotr. Mientras tanto, su hija Rita, de 19 años, se ve envuelta en una situación peligrosa, de la que es rescatada por Piotr. Ahora él es un hombre respetado en la ciudad: periodista, empresario y editor de un importante periódico local. En sus manos tiene una historia explosiva sobre corrupción con antiguas casas de campo estatales del partido, propiedades de gran valor. Entre Rita y Piotr comienza a surgir una atracción.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de su hija, pero él se mantiene firme: una vez dejó ir a su gran amor y no piensa cometer el mismo error de nuevo. Está decidido a luchar por Rita. Ksenia escucha lo mismo de su hija: ella no piensa renunciar a Piotr por la opinión de sus padres. Mientras tanto, el escándalo de las casas estatales sigue creciendo. Un colega de Piotr, Edik, descubre que su teléfono está siendo intervenido. La persona detrás de esto pertenece a la élite política. Pronto, dos desconocidos irrumpen en la oficina del periódico exigiendo que entreguen el expediente comprometedor, o la familia de Piotr estará en peligro.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Piotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres por seguridad. Ksenia acepta una tregua temporal con él. Piotr entrega su artículo para la próxima edición del periódico, pero por órdenes "desde arriba", toda la tirada es retirada bajo la acusación de difamación. Mientras tanto, Dmitri no renuncia a su plan de separar a Piotr y Rita. Se reúne con el exnovio de su hija, Aleksandr, instructor del centro náutico, y le da su visto bueno para retomar la relación con Rita… siempre y cuando logre deshacerse de Piotr.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Marina vive una vida ordinaria: trabaja como cajera en un banco y tiene una relación con su colega. Quiere aventura, peligro y emoción, pero cada día es como otro, y no le ocurre nada interesante... Hasta que unos enmascarados toman el banco, y Marina, entre los demás empleados, es tomada como rehén. Se enamora del cabecilla, aunque no pueda ver su rostro bajo la máscara.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Galia enfrenta la enfermedad terminal de su hijo Pavlik, quien necesita un costoso tratamiento en EE.UU. Mientras tanto, su distracción permite que una clienta robe en la tienda donde trabaja, lo que la pone en la mira de la policía. Por otro lado, Misha y Kolia inician su negocio de ropa ilegal, pero Kolia pierde las primeras ganancias.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha descubre cuánto necesita para el tratamiento de su hijo y decide expandir su negocio ilegal. Junto con Kolia, establece un taller de costura clandestino, pero un vecino intenta sabotearlos. Mientras avanzan en su venta de trajes de baño, la policía empieza a sospechar de sus actividades.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha y Kolia consiguen más tela con ayuda de Grigori, pero necesitan evitar levantar sospechas. Kolia obtiene una firma clave seduciendo a una secretaria. Mientras su negocio crece, un arresto inesperado pone en peligro toda la operación.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Lo que empieza como un cuento de hadas no siempre tiene un final feliz en la vida. La realidad es tal que a menudo el cuento de hadas de la vida termina con un final dramático. Los hechos tienen lugar en 1978. Una ingenua huérfana criada en un internado de provincias llega a la bulliciosa y concurrida capital. Sasha ya ha cumplido 18 años y necesita empezar una vida adulta e independiente. Una chica consigue un trabajo en la Casa de la Moda como limpiadora. Es aquí donde tiene que pasar de ser un felpudo discreto a un modelo famoso. Con el tiempo llegan a su vida hombres que le prestan todo tipo de atención. Tres hombres comienzan a cortejarla, todos ellos tratando de conquistar el corazón de Sasha: un artista de vanguardia llamado Iván, un vendedor ambulante llamado Vadim, que se ha criado en una familia muy respetable de la capital, y un mayor del KGB llamado Kim. ¡Pero Sasha ya ha elegido al hombre de sus sueños y para estar junto a él tendrá que pasar por un número increíble de pruebas!

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Sasha e Iván son felices, sin sospechar que han atraído la atención de Kim Olegovich, un mayor de la KGB y supervisor de la Casa de Modelos. Su objetivo es separarlos. Kim, sintiendo una atracción personal por Sasha, utiliza el chantaje y la manipulación para acercarse a ella. La relación entre Sasha e Iván comienza a desmoronarse ante sus ojos. Kim está a punto de lograr su propósito, pero entonces recibe una noticia inesperada: Sasha se va a casar. La noticia sacude no solo a Kim, sino también a toda la Casa de Modelos.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: La vida de Sasha con un esposo al que no ama se vuelve insoportable. Pero en su camino hacia la felicidad con Iván aún se interpone Kim Olegovich. Atrapados y sin salida, los amantes toman una decisión desesperada…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Al llegar a un acuerdo con Kim, Sasha abre el camino para su viaje a París. Iván, por su parte, planea emigrar a Israel con la intención de trasladarse después a Francia. La Casa de Modelos triunfa en sus desfiles en París, pero la estrella de la pasarela, Alexandra Linkova, está visiblemente nerviosa. Kim se da cuenta de que Sasha está planeando algo y no deja de vigilar cada uno de sus movimientos…

Kim, sintiendo una atracción personal por Sasha, utiliza el chantaje y la manipulación para acercarse a ella. La relación entre Sasha e Iván comienza a desmoronarse ante sus ojos. Kim está a punto de lograr su propósito, pero entonces recibe una noticia inesperada: Sasha se va a casar. La noticia sacude no solo a Kim, sino también a toda la Casa de Modelos.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: La vida de Sasha con un esposo al que no ama se vuelve insoportable. Pero en su camino hacia la felicidad con Iván aún se interpone Kim Olegovich. Atrapados y sin salida, los amantes toman una decisión desesperada…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Al llegar a un acuerdo con Kim, Sasha abre el camino para su viaje a París. Iván, por su parte, planea emigrar a Israel con la intención de trasladarse después a Francia. La Casa de Modelos triunfa en sus desfiles en París, pero la estrella de la pasarela, Alexandra Linkova, está visiblemente nerviosa. Kim se da cuenta de que Sasha está planeando algo y no deja de vigilar cada uno de sus movimientos…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Lo que empieza como un cuento de hadas no siempre tiene un final feliz en la vida. La realidad es tal que a menudo el cuento de hadas de la vida termina con un final dramático. Los hechos tienen lugar en 1978. Una ingenua huérfana criada en un internado de provincias llega a la bulliciosa y concurrida capital. Sasha ya ha cumplido 18 años y necesita empezar una vida adulta e independiente. Una chica consigue un trabajo en la Casa de la Moda como limpiadora. Es aquí donde tiene que pasar de ser un felpudo discreto a un modelo famoso. Con el tiempo llegan a su vida hombres que le prestan todo tipo de atención. Tres hombres comienzan a cortejarla, todos ellos tratando de conquistar el corazón de Sasha: un artista de vanguardia llamado Iván, un vendedor ambulante llamado Vadim, que se ha criado en una familia muy respetable de la capital, y un mayor del KGB llamado Kim. ¡Pero Sasha ya ha elegido al hombre de sus sueños y para estar junto a él tendrá que pasar por un número increíble de pruebas!

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mucha confusión en Camila, nada justifica las mentiras y cada vez Camila está más decepcionada de los engaños de la Madre Isabel. Ezequiel confronta a Julia y agrede salvajemente a Gregorio al encontrarlos juntos.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: La Madre Isabel confiesa a Camila pero la muchacha sabe que aún miente. Jeli, su hermanita, sufre por la irresponsabilidad de Fernando, que la embarazó. Max anuncia a Marcelina y Astrid que pronto se casará con Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Marcelina visita a la Madre Isabel para hablarle sobre su relación con Rosa Blanco, quien fue su mejor amiga y ella la traicionó; por eso quiere impedir su regreso.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ante una llamada telefónica de Rosa Blanco a Luciano, Camila, ilusionada, quiere hablar con su mamá. El Capitán Torrealba la ayude a entender los secretos que existen sobre el crimen. Ante la brutal agresión a Sebastián, Ezequiel quiere vengarla con Fernando, un Aragón.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Patricia y María Amelia habían denunciado el crimen de la muerte de Leoncio. Torrealba las enfrenta pues quiere saber cómo fue que Rosa mató a Leoncio. Patricia, desesperada, bebe sin freno. Ante su descontrol, el detective, capcioso, duda de ella.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: En las cartas que entregó Henry a Max, Rosa Blanco dice que le arrebataron a su hija y Camila, muy ansiosa, cree que, al fin sabrá por qué su mamá la abandonó. Marcelina encuentra la caja con las cartas y al saber el contenido, alterada, ordena que las quemen.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Las cartas contienen pruebas que incriminan a Patricia y a Fausto en el asesinato de Leoncio. Camila tomará decisiones importantes, sobre todo para encontrar las cuatro mujeres que traicionaron a su mamá. Fausto tiene una grave intención: hay que matar a Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: La Madre Isabel le confirma a Camila parte de los secretos que oculta: Patricia y su cuñada María Amelia fueron las que denunciaron a su madre. Luciano recibe un sobre que contiene la foto de Camila niña, con su vestidito amarillo, y detrás, una mujer protegiéndola.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Las cuatro mujeres que destruyeron la vida de Rosa Blanco se reencuentran en una casa vacía. Camila se enfrenta a Fausto acusando a Patricia de ser la asesina de Leoncio. Otra vez un motorizado le advierte que no siga buscando a su mamá y le arrebata la carta.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila explica a Ezequiel y Julia el motivo de su felicidad: se casará con Max, y también pronto se reunirá con su madre. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila divisa una mujer que corresponde a la descripción de su mamá. Antón, el sicario, también está allí y armado se dirige a ellas. Torrealba ordena a sus hombres correr hacia las mujeres, agarran a Camila y se llevan a la mujer.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: En las cartas que entregó Henry a Max, Rosa Blanco dice que le arrebataron a su hija y Camila, muy ansiosa, cree que, al fin sabrá por qué su mamá la abandonó. Marcelina encuentra la caja con las cartas y al saber el contenido, alterada, ordena que las quemen.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Las cartas contienen pruebas que incriminan a Patricia y a Fausto en el asesinato de Leoncio. Camila tomará decisiones importantes, sobre todo para encontrar las cuatro mujeres que traicionaron a su mamá. Fausto tiene una grave intención: hay que matar a Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: La Madre Isabel le confirma a Camila parte de los secretos que oculta: Patricia y su cuñada María Amelia fueron las que denunciaron a su madre. Luciano recibe un sobre que contiene la foto de Camila niña, con su vestidito amarillo, y detrás, una mujer protegiéndola.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Las cuatro mujeres que destruyeron la vida de Rosa Blanco se reencuentran en una casa vacía. Camila se enfrenta a Fausto acusando a Patricia de ser la asesina de Leoncio. Otra vez un motorizado le advierte que no siga buscando a su mamá y le arrebata la carta.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mucha confusión en Camila, nada justifica las mentiras y cada vez Camila está más decepcionada de los engaños de la Madre Isabel. Ezequiel confronta a Julia y agrede salvajemente a Gregorio al encontrarlos juntos.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: La Madre Isabel confiesa a Camila pero la muchacha sabe que aún miente. Jeli, su hermanita, sufre por la irresponsabilidad de Fernando, que la embarazó. Max anuncia a Marcelina y Astrid que pronto se casará con Camila.

programme.title: Alli Abajo
programme.desc: Iñaki vuelve de fiesta con los amigos y se encuentra a su madre preparando las maletas para salir a Sevilla. Por cosas del destino, Iñaki se ve obligado a ir con ella.

programme.title: Saras y Kumud
programme.desc: Buddhidhan le pide a Pramad que se quede en la casa de Kumud por un día. Kumud le dice a Naveenchandra que no le dirá la verdad sobre Pramad a su familia. Mientras tanto, Pramad le pide a Kalika que saque su ropa de la bolsa.

programme.title: Aqui No Hay Quien Viva
programme.desc: Mientras Paloma continúa en el hospital en estado de coma, Nieves, la hermana de Juan Cuesta, se traslada al edificio para vivir con la familia.

programme.title: Aqui No Hay Quien Viva
programme.desc: Juan e Isabel comienzan a sentirse atraídos sexualmente. Juan le confiesa a su hermana esa atracción aunque no le da nombres, y Nieves, muy posesiva, se ofende.

programme.title: Esposa Joven
programme.desc: Azad desde comisaría por teléfono pide a su madre Zumrut que hable con la abuela Nujin y le dice que no hagan daño a Zehra, no tiene por qué pagar por los pecados de otros. Zumrut dice a Behiye que si no le da pena esa niña.

programme.title: Esposa Joven
programme.desc: Rasit le dice a su hija Elif, que Zehra cometió un delito grave de deshonrar a la familia y debe pagarlo. Nujin llamó a Gülsum para verla inmediatamente.

programme.title: Alli Abajo
programme.desc: Iñaki se va acostumbrando al lugar y al sentido del humor de la gente del sur. Sólo tiene que lidiar con el enviado del seguro para poder trasladar a su madre de vuelta a la verde Euskadi.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The exclusive interview with the Ukrainian orphan who is making headlines. Is she the real life version of “The Orphan”? Natalia’s adoptive parents have been accused of abandoning her when she was just 8 years old. But they claim Natalia, who has a form of dwarfism, is really a sociopathic adult posing as a child -- who tried to kill them. Natalia speaks out for the first time to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil meets guests who say their perfect day was ruined by everything from booze, to broken down limousines, to grooms from hell, and now their marriages suffer because they can't stop reliving their wedding gone bad.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s being called the ultimate form of child abuse -- brainwashing your children against an ex-spouse to win custody. Could you be harming your child emotionally and not even know it? First up, Ken is a successful surgeon who says he’s the victim of parental alienation syndrome (PAS). He says he hasn’t seen his 14-year-old son since last October and claims his ex-wife destroyed what was once a loving father-son relationship. Mel Feit, director of the National Center for Men, says Ken’s situation is a classic case of kids being turned against their father, but family law attorney Liz Kates says PAS is a phony tactic used by some men to get out of paying child support. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, Karen lost custody of her children after she was accused of parental alienation syndrome by her ex-husband. Karen maintains her innocence, so why were her parental rights terminated when her daughters accused her ex of sexual abuse? Plus, 19-year-old Demi joins the show via Web cam and says her father verbally abused her mother during their divorce. Now, she fears that her 15-year-old sister is caught in the middle. Find out what you can do if you’re caught between sparring parents. And, meet a father so desperate to see his young children, he kidnapped them from his ex-wife and went on the lam for two years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom wants to be a better parent. A wife can’t get her husband off the couch. A husband that just can’t seem to please his finicky wife. What do all these people have in common? Dr. Phil gives them what they need to put their lives back on track in the “How To…” episode. No matter what the issue or situation, we all share problems that keep us from leader a happier, healthier life. Tune in and find yourself in our courageous guests as they face their own battles with the help of Dr. Phil McGraw. Appointment television you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What would you do if you were standing at the altar in your wedding gown, holding a bridal bouquet in a room full of family and friends ... and the groom didn’t show up? Would you seek revenge? That’s what Dr. Phil’s first guest, Dee, says she did. She says she spent over $31,000 on her special day only to be dumped by her then-fiancé, Danny. He says there’s more to the story than meets the eye. Dee and Danny haven’t seen each other in more than two years. Find out what happens when they face off on Dr. Phil’s stage and what Dee says she did to get even! And, Laurel says that while her ex-boyfriend, Brad Womack, was living life on TV as “The Bachelor,” he continued to send her text messages asking her to marry him. Brad has denied her claims in print, but Laurel says she wants to set the record straight. Plus, Dr. Phil checks back in with Marilyn, who says her fiancé left her with a big bill just six days before the wedding. When Marilyn first appeared on the show, she feared that she would never be able to trust men again. See her amazing update!

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with Heather, who says she is not at fault for her son's accidental overdose. But- where was she that night?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Times are tough, families are cracking under the pressure, and many spouses are turning on each other when the stress becomes too much. Jennifer and her husband, Ben, fight nonstop and are on the verge of divorce. She says losing her job and Ben's mom moving in are adding to the pressure. Cameras installed in their home capture the daily reality, including the ugly fighting. Once a home is shattered, is there any hope for putting the pieces back together?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Toni says her daughter, Kristine, is battling an alcohol addiction and has resorted to drinking hand sanitizer as a cheap way to get her fix. Kristine says her family is dysfunctional, and they’re the reason she can’t stay sober. Dr. Phil has words of warning for Kristine. After three failed stints in rehab, will she agree to try again -- or risk losing her daughter forever?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina and Jim are divorced, and their 21-year-old daughter, Tara, is living with her dad and his new wife who just happens to be the same age as Tara. Christina claims Jim was a horrible husband and a narcissist and she was forced to walk away from the family when Tara was just 13. Since then, she says Jim has let Tara get away with anything and now even allows her to work as a webcam model in order to help pay the bills! She says he is turning their daughter into a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A family says their relative is a cult leader who calls herself "Mother God."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They’re self-absorbed, spoiled and entitled brats, otherwise known as Generation Me. MTV correspondent Kim Stolz recently hit the streets of New York to find out how the younger generation feels about this label. Don't miss the candid responses. Then, Bradley, 24, says he wants to be rich and drive a Lamborghini, but he only wants to put in 80 percent of the effort. He still relies on his mom, Christine, to pay his rent and other bills. Will Bradley learn to stand on his own two feet? Plus, Monica says her 18-year-old daughter, Courtney, is an “entitlement princess,” and she gives the teen money just to keep the peace. Will mom and daughter get a wake-up call? And Jean Twenge, author of Generation Me, reveals why many young people are narcissistic.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four engaged couples wondering if they're ready to walk down the aisle move into The Dr. Phil House. Each couple will be put to the test to see if they really know their partner's flaws, funds, family and future expectations. After several challenges, will the couples decide to head to the altar or just call it quits? Lacey says her fiancé, Kalin, has pushed, choked and cheated on her, all while she was pregnant with their child. Kalin says he knows he had an anger problem, but claims he hasn't cheated since their baby was born. Steve is afraid of displeasing his fiancée, Stephanie, who wants to be treated like a princess. He says nothing he does is right, and anything can set off her temper. Stephanie wants more attention from Steve but is unsure if their wedding will happen because of the fighting. Scott thinks his wife-to-be, Lisa, tears down his dreams of being a musician, while Lisa thinks Scott is a male chauvinist with immature and unrealistic dreams. Tim and Lilly are just 19 years old and aren't sure they're prepared for their baby, due in two months. They want to get married but can't afford a ring or a wedding. Part 1 summary: After moving into The Dr. Phil House, Kalin gets his first assignment. Since Lacey says Kalin hasn't helped with their daughter since she was born 11 months ago, he has to care for a computerized baby that will record how well he meets its needs. The couples' first challenge is a game called Hitched or Ditched, where the couples have to guess how their partners will answer certain questions. Lisa and Scott win the game, but others question whether Scott cheated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: All couples have pet peeves that can drive each other crazy. Today Dr. Phil makes a house call on a man who keeps everything from 50 year-old receipts to his late wife’s undergarments. His current wife wants him to get rid of this stuff and asks Dr. Phil for help. Another wife comes to Dr. Phil because she is embarrassed by her husband’s inappropriate comments in public and wants him to be more socially sensitive. But he says it is his right to speak his mind. Ever wonder if Dr. Phil has any annoying habits? Tune in and hear what his wife Robin has to say!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there someone in your life you just can’t stand? Wouldn’t life be easier if you could find a way to make peace? Dr. Phil speaks with people who often struggle to get along: the ex-wife and the stepmom. Jennifer and her ex-husband’s new wife, Carol, hated each other for two years, until one pivotal moment changed their relationship forever. Together, they wrote the book No One’s the Bitch, and offer the 10 steps to strengthening the stepfamily -- starting with the women. Then, Lori says she's had a tense and rocky relationship with her husband’s ex-wife, Stephanie, and says the past eight years have been difficult. Can Dr. Phil get these two women to negotiate a new relationship? Just what are the boundaries for a stepmother? There are 1,300 stepfamilies forming every day in the U.S. Learn what you can do to ensure a happy and healthy family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say that curses are ruining their lives. Sarah is convinced she’s hexed. Then, meet a woman who claims an exorcism performed by her father 26 years ago put demons inside her!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: All couples argue, but Dr. Phil says name-calling, temper tantrums and hitting below the belt can ruin a marriage. He sits down with Mark and Leana who have been married for only five months but say they’re headed for divorce court. Leana says her husband spends more time with his band mates than he does with her and their four children. Mark says Leana constantly emasculates him, and he accuses her of being unfaithful. You won’t believe what home video cameras captured during the newlyweds' 62-minute fight. Find out what Dr. Phil witnesses that disturbs him the most. Can this couple resolve their differences, or should they call it quits? If you and your mate are having knock-down, drag-out battles, don’t miss Dr. Phil’s rules for fighting fair!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cindy and Randy are caught in a family feud with their ex-daughter-in-law, Michele, that is spiraling out of control. They want Dr. Phil to end the battle once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with some opinionated guests! Can he get them to see that their opinions and judgments can be hurtful?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Criminals, deadbeats and bad boys -- most women run from these types of men, but some women say Mr. Wrong is the right guy for them. Kelly says her daughter, Heather, married Mr. Wrong, and the price she paid was losing her children. Kelly says Heather's husband, Earl, is an unfit father and can't provide for the family. Heather, 25, says she stands by her 41-year-old husband, and wants her parents to stop sabotaging her marriage. Are Heather and Earl really unfit parents, or does Earl deserve a second chance? Then, Sarah, 29, says she's been married to three men in prison, and her current husband is serving a life sentence for murder. Even more shocking, she often takes her two young daughters to visit their stepdad behind bars, and she says they love to see him. Why is Sarah drawn to these types of men? Sarah's mom weighs in on her daughter's love life. And, a woman who gave up nearly 20 years of her life for a man in jail has an important message for Sarah. Will Sarah feel differently after meeting Darlene?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Taking the plunge. Tying the knot. Gettin’ hitched. Call it what you like, but with over half of all marriages ending in divorce, you better know what you’re getting into. Today, Dr. Phil’s guests just can’t pull the trigger. Find out how the daughters from one man’s first marriage may be getting in the way; meet a pilot who can’t give up the bachelor lifestyle; and get to know a real “runaway bride.” Are their relationships strong enough to make a lasting marriage? Decide for yourself.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's a story that captured the nation: Warren Jeffs, the leader of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints (FLDS) and self-proclaimed prophet, was one of the FBI's 10 Most Wanted Fugitives for unlawful flight, sexual conduct with a minor and conspiracy to conduct sexual conduct with a minor. Captured in 2006, Jeffs was recently convicted of sexually assaulting children and sentenced to life, plus 20 years in prison. With an estimated 10,000 followers in his polygamous sect, what will become of Warren Jeffs' victims?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Their job is to protect you. They won't let you walk down the street alone. They call your house five times a day, screen your calls, monitor your every move. No, it's not the government or the F.B.I., it's mothers! Is there such a thing as a mom having too much love for her child? Dr. Phil puts Mom to the test!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you’ve got it, flaunt it! Dr. Phil's guests say they’ve gone from ugly ducklings to hot tamales, but their loved ones think they’ve gone too far. Audrey says she looks extra hot now that she's 62 ... and she's got a 28-year-old boyfriend to prove it! Her close friend, Crystal, thinks Audrey should hang up her miniskirts and start baking cookies. Then, Bobbie lost 140 pounds and gained an insanely jealous husband because he thinks she looks way too sexy. See what happens when cameras follow Bobbie for a night on the town. Plus, a winner of the popular makeover show “The Swan” says she doesn't know how to handle her newfound beauty.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 2, Dr. Phil finally meets 28-year-old Cassie, who admits to being a drug addict since high school and using drugs with her father, Dave, in the past. Cassie ran out of the studio one hour before taping, with staffers chasing her, to buy alcohol. So, is Cassie really ready to be sober?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his discussion with Meagan and her family. Meagan is a 26-year-old anorexic and bulimic who weighs only 73 pounds. She rules her house with her eating disorders, and her family is saying enough is enough. Will she give up control and accept help before it’s too late? And, get an update on Jennifer’s family. Three months ago, they sought Dr. Phil’s help for their daughter, who was battling anorexia and bulimia. How is Jennifer doing now? Her parents, Sue and Allan, and sister, Abbey, share with Meagan’s family what they’ve learned while Jennifer has been in treatment and how they can take their lives back and stop enabling the disease. Plus, test your knowledge of eating disorders. Would you recognize the warning signs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s been more than two months since a young mother of two, Susan Powell, vanished without a trace. Susan’s husband, Josh, is now a person of interest in this case but her family claims he refuses to cooperate with police. Dr. Phil speaks with the missing woman's parents, Chuck and Judy. Learn what they have to say about what they conclude is odd behavior of Susan’s husband and why say they fear for their grandchildren. A Dr. Phil field producer travels to the camp area where Josh allegedly took his sons after midnight the night Susan disappeared. Don’t miss what she discovers! And, legal analyst Lisa Bloom weighs in on this case. Next, Ed Smart, whose daughter, Elizabeth, was kidnapped and found, knows what it’s like to be a person of interest like Josh. Hear what he says. Plus, a father whose daughter, Kimberly Medina, has been missing for 14 years shares the mistakes he thinks he’s made and has a strong message for Chuck and Judy about their grandchildren. Go behind the headlines in this heartbreaking story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When these two families first met with Dr. Phil, their lives were in chaos. Have they begun to make changes?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a headline-grabbing case, 22-year-old Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, just hours after reports of an altercation between Sheena and her fiancé, Joe, now 48. Her death was ruled a suicide, but Sheena's parents refuse to believe that their daughter would take her own life -- they feel she was murdered, and that Joe may be responsible. In an effort to clear his name, Joe comes face to face with Sheena's mother and father, Kelly and David, on Dr. Phil's stage. What does Joe say happened on the night Sheena was last seen alive? And, how does his story differ from the one Kelly and David say they've pieced together? Listen to 911 calls from that night, including one from Sheena herself. Tune in and decide for yourself: Is there more to this story than Joe is revealing?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Unemployed, unmotivated and under your roof - they're family freeloaders and they're hurting the ones they love the most. Dr. Phil has advice for a 28-year-old who still lives at home and a 20-year-old who is happy to live in his older sister's house but refuses to do any of the chores necessary to maintain it. Also, Dr. Phil finds out why a daughter thinks her mother is a gold digger.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Would you risk breaking the law for your children’s education? What about for their safety? Kelley, a single mom, made headlines when she was prosecuted, convicted and sent to jail for listing her father’s address as her daughters’ residence, so they could attend a better school in a safer neighborhood. Kelley says she was working during the day and going to school at night, and after her house was burglarized, she wanted her children in a safer neighborhood for afterschool care. Kelley was convicted of two felony counts for tampering with government documents and spent nine days in jail. Did her punishment fit the crime? And, what other lies did she get caught in? Joining the discussion are Reverend Al Sharpton, columnist Bob Dyer, attorney David Singleton and a fellow single mom in the same school district.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you’re a bride-to-be, planning your wedding can be an emotional time for you and your parents. But what happens when your family members are not exactly jumping for joy over your upcoming nuptials? From a mom who is worried her daughter is rushing into a marriage with a complete stranger to a bride who says her father is ruining her big day, Dr. Phil helps families figure out how to keep the happiest day in a young couple’s life from turning into a nightmare. And, are you sure you're preparing for a marriage and not just a wedding? Find out the questions you must ask yourself before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine if out of the blue, your spouse tells you he or she doesn’t want to be married anymore. Then you realize your partner is nearly 50 years old, is getting in shape, updating his or her wardrobe and joining Facebook! Is this a midlife crisis? Dr. Phil sits down with two couples who are on the brink of divorce. Tony and Jill have been married for four years, but Tony says he wants out, so he can have his freedom back and not have the pressure and responsibility of having a wife. Their divorce will be final in a few weeks -- so why is Jill still sleeping with him? And, Miles says his wife of 10 years, Elaine, is going through a midlife crisis and that’s the reason why she’s had an affair. Elaine says she doesn’t regret her indiscretions because the other man made her feel happy and alive. Is there hope for these unions? Find out the warning signs of a midlife crisis and what Dr. Phil says these couples must do before calling it quits!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tricia says her 12-year-old daughter, Rebecca Ann, tragically took her own life in 2013 after being cyberbullied. Now, Tricia claims she not only is being harassed online by a stranger –who shares the same name as her deceased daughter --but she also is being accused of the unthinkable. Tempers flare when the women come face to face for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. How can Tricia move forward in peace and finally grieve her daughter’s loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine discovering that your next-door neighbor owns over 200 cats. Ray and Dennis never thought their neighbor, Kristy, would let her pet collection get that big. Once friends, the three are now in a nasty and vindictive war because of the felines. Ray and Dennis say Kristy's property is one big, disgusting litter box, and they want Kristy to get rid of her cats. Kristy says she'll never part with her "cat sanctuary." Are Ray and Dennis playing dirty in order to run Kristy out of town? When is it too much, and where do you draw the line in the litter box? Then, Mike says his wife, Lori, keeps everything from used envelopes to empty food jars and medicine bottles, because she "might need it" in the future. He is ready to take desperate measures to put a stop to this. Lori says the thought of throwing her stuff out is her worst nightmare. Is Mike guilty of making nasty bribes to get his wife to change? What's really behind Lori's habit for hoarding?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Dr. Phil exclusive. A beautiful teen goes missing on spring break. Now, 7 years later, shocking new allegations – was Brittanee kidnapped, killed, and thrown into a gator pit? Her family gives their first interview since hearing the nightmarish details about what a jailhouse informant claims happened to their daughter. Plus, hear what a surprising guest has to say – do they know something about Brittanee’s murder?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Witness the “boomerang effect...” Dr. Phil talks to parents whose adult children keep coming back to live with, and off of them. One couple says their sons refuse to move out even though they are both almost 30-years-old. One 25- year-old is unemployed, has had 16 jobs in seven years, lives with his mother and even took her credits cards to charge up two thousand dollars worth of “stuff.” Dr. Phil helps these adult children address their issues so they can stop their destructive patterns.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Anything goes on “Ask Dr. Phil"! A 25-year-old claims she won’t find happiness until she becomes a millionaire…and would even ditch her loved ones to get it! Is her search for wealth unreasonable? Then, meet one empty nester who cries everyday about her daughter leaving for college—and it’s been four years! Also, you’ll be surprised to find out why one woman wouldn’t pick up the phone, even if her life depended on it!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The new series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story may have landed the number one spot on Netflix, but it wasn’t popular with everyone. Angry family members of Dahmer’s victims say the controversial drama re-traumatized them and romanticized the notorious serial killer. You’ve seen Hollywood’s version. Today, Dr. Phil is telling the real story and meeting the real people who say they knew the real monster that was Jeffrey Dahmer. In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil takes a hard look into the life of identical twin sisters, Talia and Alissa, who say they are homeless and addicted to heroin, and that nothing seems to stop them from scoring drugs – no matter who it hurts. Watch as they share their daily lives with the Dr. Phil cameras and hear them discuss being 21-year-old “prostitutes” together, explain that they have stolen change from a blind man and once stole from over 50 residents at a nursing home, all to get money for heroin. Dr. Phil’s offer of help includes something so radical, it’s a Dr. Phil show first, surprising the twins, their family and the studio audience. But will Talia and Alissa accept the help offered to try to save their lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Whether it's personal guilt or family pressure, many couples feel a tremendous need to rush to the altar. Heather and Jeff were virgins when they started dating. After their relationship started heating up, Heather feared judgment from her minister father and ran down the aisle with Jeff. Now their home is full of resentment. Why is she disappointed with Jeff and is there hope for their future? Next, Michelle said she had doubts about marrying Steve as she was walking down the aisle. Find out what is causing the overwhelming conflict in their marriage nine years later? Plus, two best friends are plotting to make sure their kids get married! But what do the teens think?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil once again exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge of committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live with the fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Joanna says her rage is scaring her son. Michelle’s rage has driven her to slap her child and hit her with a wooden spoon. Lisa admits to pulling her daughter’s hair when she gets angry. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four engaged couples wondering if they're ready to walk down the aisle move into The Dr. Phil House. Each couple will be put to the test to see if they really know their partner's flaws, funds, family and future expectations. After several challenges, will the couples decide to head to the altar or just call it quits? Lacey says her fiancé, Kalin, has pushed, choked and cheated on her, all while she was pregnant with their child. Kalin says he knows he had an anger problem, but claims he hasn't cheated since their baby was born. Steve is afraid of displeasing his fiancée, Stephanie, who wants to be treated like a princess. He says nothing he does is right, and anything can set off her temper. Stephanie wants more attention from Steve but is unsure if their wedding will happen because of the fighting. Scott thinks his wife-to-be, Lisa, tears down his dreams of being a musician, while Lisa thinks Scott is a male chauvinist with immature and unrealistic dreams. Tim and Lilly are just 19 years old and aren't sure they're prepared for their baby, due in two months. They want to get married but can't afford a ring or a wedding. Part 1 summary: After moving into The Dr. Phil House, Kalin gets his first assignment. Since Lacey says Kalin hasn't helped with their daughter since she was born 11 months ago, he has to care for a computerized baby that will record how well he meets its needs. The couples' first challenge is a game called Hitched or Ditched, where the couples have to guess how their partners will answer certain questions. Lisa and Scott win the game, but others question whether Scott cheated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Amanda has been missing for five months. Her parents believe she ran away with her boyfriend and what they call his "gypsy family." Dr. Phil puts his own investigator on the case to go in search of the runaway teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores a disturbing trend: Female teachers engaging in sex acts with their underage male students. The number of accusations has doubled in the past five years. You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More than 170,000 U.S. troops are stationed in Iraq and Afghanistan, sacrificing life and limb to keep America safe. Nearly 40,000 have been wounded, an estimated 300,000 are living with Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), and in 2005, there were at least 6,256 suicides among those serving in the armed forces. Many vets say when they return home, they feel mistreated and neglected and are forced to fight a medical system bureaucracy that doesn't hear them. Are we doing enough to care for our heroes? Find out what's really going on as Dr. Phil tackles this hot-button issue!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sheryl says it was love at first sight when she met her optometrist fiancé, Owen, in 2010 -- but the real eye opener came two years later, when she moved from Florida to New York to live with him and his three children. She claims that Owen, who makes six figures, refused to give her any spending money and treated her like the nanny and housekeeper -- all while she slept on a futon in the living room. Frustrated, she moved back to Florida a year later and called off the wedding -- so, why is she still wearing her engagement ring? Owen says Sheryl expects him to pay for everything, his friends and family disapprovingly call her a “gold digger” -- but he still wants to marry her! Dr. Phil offers the couple advice for moving forward. Should they proceed to the altar -- or alter their plans?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Times are tough, families are cracking under the pressure, and many spouses are turning on each other when the stress becomes too much. Jennifer and her husband, Ben, fight nonstop and are on the verge of divorce. She says losing her job and Ben's mom moving in are adding to the pressure. Cameras installed in their home capture the daily reality, including the ugly fighting. Once a home is shattered, is there any hope for putting the pieces back together?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to controlling, combative, outspoken guests whose loved ones want them off their back! First up, Tia demands perfection from her kids in school, music and sports. She's even picked out the perfect bride for her 14-year-old son! Then, he’s been called “the worst husband in Dr. Phil history!” When Deanna and Mike last appeared on Dr. Phil, Mike shocked the nation when he told his wife to “shut her suck hole!” He even tells her how to brush her teeth and take showers. Now they are back! Find out how their relationship has changed, and what will happen if Mike’s old habits re-appear!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Good fences make good neighbors, but Dr. Phil's guests say no matter how high the fence, they can't seem to end their vicious feud.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2010, 24-year-old Michelle O’Connell was found shot to death in what authorities ruled a suicide -- a case that was recently ordered reopened by the governor of Florida. Michelle’s mother, Patricia, and sister, Jennifer, insist the young mother never would have taken her own life, and they believe Michelle’s boyfriend, Jeremy -- a sheriff’s deputy -- killed her, which he denies. Michelle’s brother, Scott -- also a sheriff’s deputy -- supports Jeremy and says his mother and sister need to stop living in denial. How does he answer his mother’s accusation that he’s betraying his family to save his job? Dr. Phil brings this fractured family together in search of answers. What happened to Michelle that night? Hear from one of the first responders on the scene -- why does she believe the initial finding of suicide was wrong? Plus, can this family put their differences aside and come together and grieve for Michelle?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are we raising a generation of ungrateful children? Melissa’s sisters say her sons are the most spoiled boys in North America. They get everything they want – all they have to do is whine. Melissa says her kids just like toys, and she thinks her sisters may be jealous of her lifestyle. Next, Dori admits that her 13-year-old son, Parker, is spoiled. Parker says he won't take no for an answer, and even has a strategy for getting everything he wants. Find out what's behind Dori's need to spoil Parker. Then, Joan says her 14-year-old daughter, Jacquie, is a snob, and her need for trendy clothes is turning her into a materialistic monster. Plus, Lauren spends her entire paycheck shopping, but with no money in her checking account, she’s afraid she could be headed for trouble. Her mom, Diane, says she's not worried, it's just Lauren's way of relaxing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Obsessed! First, meet a group of women who can’t get enough of a new craze called reborning -- crafting infant dolls that are so life-like, people mistake them for real babies. Some spend thousands of dollars on their dolls, as if they were real children. Author and comedienne Stefanie Wilder-Taylor spends some time with the doting doll lovers during a party you have to see to believe. Then, Anona says she’s obsessed with her hair, which she hasn’t cut in 17 years. Anona says she’s ready for a change, but how will she react when actress Vivica A. Fox and celebrity stylist Phillip Bloch get their hands on her? Don’t miss this amazing makeover! Plus, a mom is concerned over her 7-year-old’s obsession with all things Elvis. And, Vivica A. Fox spills the beans about an obsession she shares with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin … that even Dr. Phil wasn’t aware of!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Taking the plunge. Tying the knot. Gettin’ hitched. Call it what you like, but with over half of all marriages ending in divorce, you better know what you’re getting into. Today, Dr. Phil’s guests just can’t pull the trigger. Find out how the daughters from one man’s first marriage may be getting in the way; meet a pilot who can’t give up the bachelor lifestyle; and get to know a real “runaway bride.” Are their relationships strong enough to make a lasting marriage? Decide for yourself.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bill says he believes he is a narcissist after pushing away almost all of his loved ones, including his brother Tom and daughter Bridget, who both stopped speaking to him. After a tense reunion with Tom, Bill gets emotional when Dr. Phil reunites him with Bridget. After violent fights, cruel words, and selfish behavior, will Bill start taking accountability and change?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There comes a point when every child must grow up and face life on their own. For today’s guests, that time has come and gone and they want stay with Mom and Dad! You’ll meet Ryan, whose father says he’s borrowed over $10,000, and has trouble standing on his own two feet. And watch as Dr. Phil gives another young adult the tools she needs to create a life of her own. Find out what needs to happen before your offspring fly the coop.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom wants to be a better parent. A wife can’t get her husband off the couch. A husband that just can’t seem to please his finicky wife. What do all these people have in common? Dr. Phil gives them what they need to put their lives back on track in the “How To…” episode. No matter what the issue or situation, we all share problems that keep us from leader a happier, healthier life. Tune in and find yourself in our courageous guests as they face their own battles with the help of Dr. Phil McGraw. Appointment television you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The 1957 kidnapping and murder of Maria Ridulph went cold for 55 years, until Jack McCullough, once known as John Tessier, was arrested and eventually convicted -- despite maintaining his innocence. Dr. Phil speaks to family members on both sides. Could McCullough have been wrongfully convicted?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Seven years ago, Brandon was an out-of-control drug addict, until his LIVE intervention on the Dr. Phil stage led him down the path to sobriety. Now clean for five years, Brandon and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by helping other families confront their loved ones about their destructive addictions. A family desperate to save their three drug-addicted brothers: Sean, 28, Jordan, 24, and Logan, 23, reaches out to Brandon and Debbie for help. It’s an unpredictable event fraught with issues. Don’t miss this dramatic triple intervention!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: YouTube sensation “Homeless Joe,” 26, survives on the mean streets of Manhattan by panhandling during the day and picking up women at night. Joe admits he could get a place of his own if he stopped drinking but says being homeless without alcohol is unbearable. Is this “cardboard Casanova” interested in turning his life around?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nobody likes a know-it-all, but what if you’re married to one? Kenton says his bags are packed, because he can’t take his wife’s criticism anymore. One more blow up and he’s ready to walk! Next—Jay says his wife Kristin is uneducated, absent-minded, and an easy target. She’s tired of being the butt of his jokes and wants it to end. And, Jeremy says his new wife can’t follow “the rules!” Is their 4-month-old marriage on the brink of collapse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Their job is to protect you. They won't let you walk down the street alone. They call your house five times a day, screen your calls, monitor your every move. No, it's not the government or the F.B.I., it's mothers! Is there such a thing as a mom having too much love for her child? Dr. Phil puts Mom to the test!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pat and his wife, Sarah, claim they’re scared for their family’s safety. Pat claims his father, John, is delusional, violent, paranoid and so dangerous, that Pat sleeps on the couch in his living room to protect his wife and two children in the event that John comes to the house at night to harm them. Pat and Sarah say John’s delusions have gotten so bad they’ve had to cut ties with him. John, on the other hand, completely denies the allegations. He says his daughter-in-law is to blame for stealing his son, filling his head with evil and turning Pat against him. Can Dr. Phil bridge the gap between father and son and bring this whole family back together again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 12 years of marriage, Ed revealed to Kandi that he'd been having an affair and his mistress is now pregnant. Dr. Phil continues his in-depth look at the anatomy of an affair.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with a woman who claims she is "Mother God."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil looks into the nature of passive aggressive and pessimistic behaviors. One wife needs Dr. Phil’s help dealing with her passive aggressive husband. He never tells her what he’s thinking and often leaves to avoid confrontation. She says this punishment is hurtful and has their marriage in serious jeopardy. Plus, meet a college student whose negativity is alienating her from friends and potential boyfriends. Tune in for Dr. Phil’s cure for this bad case of bad attitude.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is compulsive spending ruining your life? According to a recent Gallup poll, the average American owes $29,000 in credit card debt, and last year, 1.6 million U.S. households filed for bankruptcy. Dr. Phil has advice for avoiding credit card catastrophes this holiday season.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after graduation, Dr. Phil's guests say they can't shake their high school image and are striving to overcome their deeply rooted insecurities. Plus, Dr. Phil reveals the common characteristics of victims of bullies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heather and Chris say their six-year marriage is on the brink of divorce because of their constant heated arguments, which they admit happen almost daily, in front of their two young children. Heather, a stay-at-home mom, says Chris is so controlling that he constantly accuses her of cheating on him, checks her phone records to see whom she’s calling and won’t let her handle their finances. Chris says Heather is only with him for the money and has gotten violent with him during their disagreements -- some of which have been caught on tape. He says she has kicked him in the privates, slapped him in the face and thrown a tape measure at his head -- all in front of the kids. What’s driving the couple’s anger? Plus, Chris recently filed for divorce -- will he change his mind and agree to work on their marriage? Then, Kerry says she and her husband, Sam, engage in explosive fighting at least four times a week, and she fears someone will get seriously hurt. Can this couple learn to fight fairly? This program contains strong language. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Chandra and her siblings, Charity, Perry and Preston, say their mother, Pamela’s, hoarding is so out of control that nearly every inch of her 9,000-square-foot home is filled with “junk.” The siblings say that growing up, Pamela would pick through their garbage to save items, which forced them to sneak trash out of the house. They say as they got older, her hoarding became progressively worse, prompting them to stage an intervention in 2012, which escalated to the point of police being called. Pamela says she feels her family unfairly “ganged up” on her and insists she’s not a hoarder -- so, how does she explain the mess? Plus, Pamela’s husband, Richard, moved out of the house two years ago -- he says because of the hoarding, but she says otherwise. Hear why Pamela claims Richard is equally to blame for the family’s problems. Can Dr. Phil help Pamela get rid of her clutter -- and help this family get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What do you do when life’s problems seem so overwhelming that it feels like there’s no way out? Kenny, who was one of the first responders to the 9/11 tragedy, says he still struggles with post-traumatic stress disorder and other health challenges. His wife, Cyndi, and daughter, Gina, say he just sits on the couch and obsesses about that fateful day, and they feel he needs to get over it. Can Kenny get his life and his health back? Then, Steve and Jacki have been married for four years, and Steve says he’s at a crossroads in his relationship. He says his wife puts him last and moved her elderly parents into their home while he was on the road. Jacki says she can’t get over her husband’s insensitivity to her dying mother, and isn’t sure if their relationship can be saved. Is it time for Steve to say enough is enough and move on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The case of Thomas Cogdell, who confessed to his sister's muder at age 12, is examined.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to families, conflict is nearly inevitable, but when you add the stress of a mental illness, it can divide even the closest knit household. Coni’s 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at 12. Since then, her daughter’s behavior has been violent and erratic, and Coni says the chaos is tearing their family apart. Coni’s husband has threatened divorce, her oldest son has moved out, and her youngest daughter says her childhood was awful because of her older sister. The family thinks Katherine should be moved to a facility that can better serve her, but Coni says that is not an option. Learn what Dr. Phil says this family is doing wrong and how they can create a happy, peaceful household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does your child lie, steal, swear, or test you daily? Karen and Matt's son is only 4 years old, but he’s already cursing! Patty and Eric's 8-year-old son has been stealing since kindergarten. Now, they’re worried this could lead to a life of crime. Plus, a boy whose nickname is Dracula because he’s always biting somebody! And, what if you kept finding your 4-year-old in his birthday suit with the little girl next door? Beverly and Shea say they can't figure out why their kids like to get naked and play.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cindy and Jim say they are fed up with their 35-year-old son, Brandon. They say he’s a moocher who refuses to get job, wears superhero costumes on a daily basis, and has caused $15,000 in damages to their property. Brandon says his parents don’t understand how his mind works. He admits to wearing superhero costumes and going on nightly “Batman” vigilante missions. Brandon says he also created a rapper persona named “Ceeza Caprice” and considers himself a “God MC” who can rap to any beat. Brandon’s sister, Harmony, says she blames her parents for Brandon’s behavior. She says they enable Brandon. She claims Brandon is a manipulator who sees it as a challenge to live off others.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil rings in 2005 with a “New Year’s Resolutions Week” to help you make changes that really matter! Today he helps tackle the number one issue couples fight about – Money! Eris and Vivian spend so much on designer clothes, they cut out costs that really matter - like groceries! They’ve filed for bankruptcy once, have a home in foreclosure, are more than $28,000 in debt…and they still can’t stop shopping! Thai and CJ live paycheck-to-paycheck and even started to sell their kids' old clothes on eBay just to make ends meet. Dr. Phil has some action plans that can help them and you reach your goals.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina and Jim are divorced, and their 21-year-old daughter, Tara, is living with her dad and his new wife who just happens to be the same age as Tara. Christina claims Jim was a horrible husband and a narcissist and she was forced to walk away from the family when Tara was just 13. Since then, she says Jim has let Tara get away with anything and now even allows her to work as a webcam model in order to help pay the bills! She says he is turning their daughter into a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The mother/daughter relationship can take many forms: best friends, parent-child, and in the case of today’s guests, adversaries. You’ll meet one mom who’s driving her daughter crazy with constant phone calls and unexpected visits. Are her actions creating the separation she fears most? Find out how another mom’s money mismanagement has her daughter feeling both financially and emotionally at risk. Moms, daughters and trust - on the next Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 1 of two episodes, Dr. Phil meets Cheryl, her ex-husband, Dave, and their youngest daughter, Stephanie, who say oldest daughter Cassie has been a drug addict and an alcoholic for years and needs an intervention. One source of contention is the allegation that Dave not only did drugs with Cassie but also received money from her that she admittedly earned through prostitution. Dave counters that, despite using drugs with Cassie twice, he did not encourage Cassie to be a prostitute and he gave back the money Cassie earned through prostitution. Dave contends that he is actually fighting for Cassie’s sobriety and has helped save her life by giving her a home to live in. Things take an uncertain turn when Cassie decides to leave the studio one hour before the taping and run down Melrose Avenue to a liquor store with staffers chasing her. Will Cassie ever make it to stage to talk to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: An engagement symbolizes a commitment you make to one special person. But Dr. Phil's guests are accused of the ultimate betrayal: cheating on their spouse-to-be right before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Pim y Pom en el Museo
programme.desc: Pim y Pom, dos gatitos, llevan a los niños a una aventura en el fascinante mundo del arte. Con la fuerza de su imaginación, exploran cuadros de artistas famosos como Vincent van Gogh, Johannes Vermeer, Rembrandt, Seurat y Renoir.

programme.title: Las aventuras de los bebés llorones Lágrimas mágicas
programme.desc: Los Bebés Llorones viven en el mundo de Lágrimas Mágicas donde aprenden juntos lo que es la amistad, el trabajo en equipo y la empatía. Disfruta con ellos aventuras increíbles en mundos llenos de magia. Cada uno de los Bebés Llorones es único, pero todos tienen algo en común: ¡sus lágrimas son mágicas!

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
